question: What universal range must the meditated object encompass in every place?
premises: The object is meditated upon in place after place.
The meditation has a specified range.
That range extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: The practitioner must meditate on that presence as pervading all levels from Shiva to Avici.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in place after place, as extending from Shiva down to Avici.
